page.notes: The scan is cut off at the foot, so the last line of the text is incomplete and marked illegible. The marginal note reading "trepidates" is uncertain. The reference mark "r" is taken from the text as it appears on the scan. Printed spelling kept where it is not u/v or i/j, including "aliys", "obnoxij" changed to "obnoxi" as a vowel i. The right-margin note's opening mark is a dagger-like symbol that is not clearly matched by a mark in the text; it is marked [?]. The text mark for the second note is an asterisk after "vbi". The note "Supra lit. φ." is partly uncertain. The catchword "tum" sits at the right below the last line, with the word broken as "Sacerdo-". Parts of the first note (e.g. "facium", "Eudae-monis") are doubtful. Only the visible part of the page was transcribed.
